_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: a caller that discards the returned reset-to-0 is stranded on a non-zero page — the reset does NOT stick without a commit
expectedRed.why: On correct code the reset must win even for a negligent caller: the third render returns 0, so `expect(consumer.renders[2]).toBe(0)` fails with an AssertionError (the hook clamps back to 1). If this test passes, the reset-to-0 has been made to stick without a commit — the bug is fixed or the proof cannot measure it.
